mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qa_messages (conversation_id, user_id, question, answer, search_sources, referenced_knowledge_ids, suggested_tags) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{question}, #{answer}, CAST(#{searchSources} AS JSONB), #{referencedKnowledgeIds}, #{suggestedTags})
mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, user_id, question, answer, CAST(search_sources AS TEXT) AS search_sources, referenced_knowledge_ids, suggested_tags, created_at FROM qa_messages WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id
